title.zh: 将西达沃省 Don Marcelino 市镇 Lapuan 描笼涯一所国立中学的附属校分离，改设为独立的 Luisa Joyce Mallari 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Lawa National High School Annex in Barangay Lapuan, Municipality of Don Marcelino, Province of Davao Occidental From the Lawa National High School, Converting It Into an Independent National High School to be Known as Luisa Joyce Mallari National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Lawa National High School Annex in Barangay Lapuan, Municipality of Don Marcelino, Province of Davao Occidental From the Lawa National High School, Converting It Into an Independent National High School to be Known as Luisa Joyce Mallari National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu của Trường Trung học Lawa Quốc gia tại Barangay Lapuan, Đô thị Don Marcelino, Tỉnh Davao Occidental khỏi Trường Trung học Lawa Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Luisa Joyce Mallari Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขตของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Lawa แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Lapuan เทศบาล Don Marcelino จังหวัด Davao Occidental ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Lawa แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Luisa Joyce Mallari แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Lawa Nasional di Barangay Lapuan, Kotamadya Don Marcelino, Provinsi Davao Occidental dari Sekolah Menengah Lawa Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Luisa Joyce Mallari Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Lawa Kebangsaan di Barangay Lapuan, Perbandaran Don Marcelino, Wilayah Davao Occidental daripada Sekolah Menengah Lawa Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Luisa Joyce Mallari Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Lawa National High School Annex in Barangay Lapuan, Municipality of Don Marcelino, Province of Davao Occidental is hereby separated from the Lawa National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Luisa Joyce Mallari National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities, and records of the Lawa National High School Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Luisa Joyce Mallari National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Luisa Joyce Mallari National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Lawa National High School Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act within one hundred twenty (120) days after its effectivity.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
